definitions.gloss: hard struggle; strenuous effort; fighting hard
definitions.explanation: putting forth great effort and energy in a difficult situation

examples.english: The players fought hard until the end.

notes:
{奮闘|ふんとう} describes putting forth great effort in a challenging situation.

ETYMOLOGY:
- {奮|ふん}: To rouse oneself, be vigorous
- {闘|とう}: To fight, struggle

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {奮闘|ふんとう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to struggle hard)
- {奮闘|ふんとう}⟦ぶり→〜ぶり：28358_buri⟧ (the way one struggles)
- ⟦{孤軍奮闘|こぐんふんとう}→孤軍奮闘：30303_kogunfuntou⟧ (fighting alone against many)
- ⟦{悪戦苦闘|あくせんくとう}→悪戦苦闘：20178_akusenkutou⟧ (desperate struggle - similar idiom)

USAGE:
- Sports: Players fighting hard in a game
- Work: Employees putting in great effort
- Personal: Struggling with life challenges
- News: Describing someone's determined efforts
- Implies admirable effort despite difficulties
- Often used positively to praise someone's hard work
- Can be used even when the outcome is not successful

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{善戦|ぜんせん}→善戦：07902_zensen⟧ (good fight - focus on performance)
- ⟦{健闘|けんとう}→健闘：15326_kentou⟧ (good fight - similar meaning)
- ⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧ (effort - more general)
- ⟦{頑張|がんば}る→頑張る：01222_ganbaru⟧ (to do one's best - more casual)

REGISTER: Neutral. Common in sports commentary and news.
